B · per-agent attribution — savings rows joined to a call's agent

  per-agent attribution unavailable — none of the 2 savings rows
  carry a link cage can resolve to an agent (see the breakdown below)

· coverage: 0 of 2 savings rows (0%) are agent-attributable
· agent-unknown: 2 graphify row(s) carry no call and no session
    — the interceptor runs as a subprocess and cannot know which agent spawned it
    (structural, not a capture gap)
· no savings row attributed to: claude
